messages:
jamie: Heads-up: "Nightshade" external pentest kickoff next Tue. Need final runbook for readroom access, KMS handling, and retest acceptance criteria. Who can own assessor creds and evidence pass?

sasha: I can own assessor creds. Plan: ephemeral IAM role per assessor, session duration 4h, require MFA and IP allowlist. Will add explicit deny for iam:CreateAccessKey. Dry-run tomorrow 09:30? :white_check_mark:

ricardo: Questions about KMS: prefer not to grant kms:Decrypt to assessors. Can we provide an audit-only decrypt proxy so decrypts happen inside an encrypted audit VM and assessors only see artifacts?

maria: Yes. Use envelope encryption + a KMS proxy service. Proxy performs Decrypt in VPC with KMS CMK, writes decrypted artifact to ephemeral S3 object with short TTL for assessor retrieval. No key material leaves our environment. Also enable CloudTrail data events + KMS key rotation logs to the forensics bucket.

jamie: Proposed artifact layout: s3://redwood-pt/proofs/<engagement>/<artifact>. Must include metadata: checksum, uploader, and created_by. Presigned URLs expire in 12-24h. We will snapshot checksums before handing off.

sasha: I'll draft the IAM policy and a short runbook snippet. Quick sample policy attached in branch (pt/runbook-kms-proxy).

ops-bot: CI: branch pt/runbook-kms-proxy created by sasha 3 checks queued.

ricardo: Retest acceptance: (1) evidence present with matching checksum, (2) CloudTrail shows S3:GetObject by assessor role during window, (3) KMS proxy logs show decrypt event with request-id. If any mismatch, fail retest and reopen ticket.

maria: Retention: keep CloudTrail + KMS logs for minimum 120 days for this engagement to cover retest and dispute windows. Export daily snapshots to secure archive bucket with strict ACLs.

oncall: I'll be oncall for the retest window (2025-03-10 to 2025-03-14). Escalate to me for any missing logs or access breaks.

jamie: Next steps recap: (1) sasha pushes policy + runbook (2) maria configures KMS proxy & CloudTrail exports (3) ricardo prepares presigned artifact layout and checksum snapshot (4) ops runs dry-run tomorrow 09:30. Reconvene after dry-run to lock retest dates. :lock:

sasha: ack. Inviting ops & oncall to dry-run. Join: https://meet.redwood.com/pt-dryrun

ops-bot: Reminder: dry-run tomorrow 09:30 UTC.
